title: Secondhand Investment Trends | October 2026
summary:
Main
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-11 151951.png | assets/2026-11-11_secondhand-investment-trends-october-2026_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_ed6d856d511f.png
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-11 152110.png | assets/2026-11-11_secondhand-investment-trends-october-2026_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_0561a747cf2d.png
October's secondhand sale-and-purchase market points to a change in where investors are deploying capital, rather than an across-the-board acceleration in buying. Tanker transactions expanded sharply, while dry bulk turnover contracted. At the same time, disclosed spending across all vessel sectors fell from September, highlighting the difference between the number of ships changing hands and the amount of capital committed.
